title: Autonomous agents: what runs an agent when no one is in the conversation?
summary: The page needs a qualification to its pay-as-you-go assurance. Microsoft's updated billing documentation says prepaid-credit exhaustion does not block agents in those environments, but administrator-disabled agents and agents that reach a stop-usage monthly limit remain blocked. Both governance paths and both PowerShell calls are supported, including the three-dots step flagged by the pre-check.
